notes: Implements the minimum phase-1 remediation slice by compiling deterministic remediation responses to supported status-artifact drift rules.
Adds a phase-2 dry-run structured remediation preview that simulates canonical status artifact outputs and emits deterministic diff excerpts without mutating the workspace.
Adds a phase-3 applied remediation path that reuses the existing governed status-artifact writers, verifies the regenerated outputs, and restores the pre-apply artifact state if verification fails.

Adds a Phase 4 bounded source-level remediation slice that synchronizes missing `inf_work` package re-exports in `src/inf_work/__init__.py` when the governed package-public-API doc references symbols that resolve to exactly one provider module.
Adds a Phase 5 intent-driven governed change entry point for deterministic status-artifact refresh so operators can request a bounded capability directly without requiring an active status failure.

Reuses existing status and knowledge-base validation outputs instead of introducing ad hoc mutation flows, keeping the supported slices bounded to governed artifact planning, bounded artifact execution, and deterministic package-export source synchronization.
